standard.summary: 按标签频率调节 caption tag dropout
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Adjusts caption tag dropout by tag frequency
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 按标签频率调节 caption tag dropout；关闭时保持均匀随机。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Adjusts caption tag dropout by tag frequency; when off, dropout stays uniformly random. Off by default.
